data.review_body: I used to be a regular customer, but after my recent experiences with Temu, I strongly advise everyone to be extremely cautious. Temu heavily advertises their "Local Warehouse" delivery as a major feature, but in reality, you pay the exact same price (or sometimes higher) as you would on major marketplaces like Amazon. The difference is that Amazon delivers the item the same day or next day, while Temu's "local" package takes weeks to arrive from halfway across the country, completely missing their guaranteed delivery windows. On top of that, most items are extremely low quality—what looks decent in pictures turns out to be cheap trash. The app is also filled with predatory and manipulative games like Farmland and Fishland designed to waste your time and trick you into buying useless items. When a package is delayed past the contract deadline or misdelivered, customer service becomes a complete nightmare. I spent 3.5 hours in support chats being repeatedly gaslighted. They accept invalid "proof of delivery" photos (like a package sitting on a driver's lap in their vehicle or generic photos without unit numbers) while demanding buyers file police reports for minor missing items. Even when you explicitly cancel an order due to a breach of delivery terms, they ignore you, force the late package onto your doorstep, and refuse a proper refund. To make matters worse, instead of returning funds to the original payment card they unlawfully dump it into Temu Credits to trap your money in their ecosystem. I have had to file formal claims with the Better Business Bureau (BBB) and initiate bank disputes to get my money back. Temu lies even in their official responses to regulators, claiming "no record of cancellation" despite hours of documented chat history. Avoid this platform—the savings are fake, the logistics are unreliable, and the customer service is predatory.

They have lost a customer going forward this whole debacle is disgraceful. It shouldn’t be this hard to return faulty goods.

data.review_body: You can get some good prices and cute things, so much to choose from. But if you want to return  something or cancel an item or two before it has even shipped they do not give you all your money back. They do an adjustment and don't even tell you what percentage which they should give you a full refund if it's within hours and not pulled, packed or shipped. They split up orders and you do not always get the price you see advertised  so watch out. I read you can only get one promotional price per shipment and if you choose more than one item you don't get the price. That is very deceiving  to me as well as not being able to return stuff like they say you can.  But it is all in writing you just have to dig for it after the fact and learn how and why it happened. Delivery time can take up to 3 weeks you are suppose to get a $5 credit if not received on time but they sent me an email and text saying it will take longer for some reason and they extended the time so that's also a lie on their part. There is nobody you can contact or call if you have questions. Just make sure it is really what you want because it's a 50/50 gamble. Some things are spot on and others are totally off. The  good thing is nothing really costs that much so you are not out very much money. Then there are really good items that you get for a very reasonable price. I don't like that if the seller charges $2.99 for shipping it's for each piece say if you buy 2 items. It should just be a flat rate. These are the little things you learn along the way. Also there is a time limit on promos and if you don't buy before that time  is up then you don't get that price.  I have bought and spent a lot of money, hundreds of dollars and just recently tried to return or cancel something and learned the hard way so therefore I am now done with this company. I just don't like their policy or practices and it's just a personal preference for me.
